# One.com
> One.com provides domain registration, web hosting, website building, WordPress hosting, email, and online business tools.

One.com offers consumer and small-business web services including domains, hosting, managed WordPress, website creation, email, and ecommerce. Its site is localized across multiple European languages and includes product pages, support resources, and customer account access.

## Core Products
- [Domain Names](https://www.one.com/en/domain): Search, register, and manage domain names for websites and businesses.
- [Web Hosting](https://www.one.com/en/web-hosting): Shared hosting plans with website, email, and domain-related features.
- [Website Builder](https://www.one.com/en/websitebuilder): Drag-and-drop website creation for beginners and small businesses.
- [WordPress Hosting](https://www.one.com/en/wordpress-hosting): Managed WordPress hosting with setup, performance, and maintenance features.
- [Email Hosting](https://www.one.com/en/email): Professional email hosting tied to custom domains.
- [Online Shop](https://www.one.com/en/online-shop): Ecommerce tools for creating and running an online store.

## Hosting and Site Creation
- [Managed VPS](https://www.one.com/en/vps): Virtual private servers for users needing more control and resources.
- [Website Builder Templates](https://www.one.com/en/websitebuilder/templates): Prebuilt templates for quickly launching different website types.
- [Booking Plugin](https://www.one.com/en/websitebuilder/booking): Online booking functionality for service-based websites.
- [SEO Tools](https://www.one.com/en/websitebuilder/seo): Search engine optimization features for improving site visibility.
- [Google Business Profile](https://www.one.com/en/websitebuilder/google-business-profile): Connect website presence with Google Business Profile tools.
- [Site Performance](https://www.one.com/en/web-hosting): Hosting features related to speed, uptime, and reliability.

## WordPress
- [WordPress Hosting Overview](https://www.one.com/en/wordpress-hosting): Managed hosting environment tailored for WordPress websites.
- [WordPress Website Builder](https://www.one.com/en/wordpress-hosting/website-builder): Build WordPress sites with integrated creation tools.
- [WordPress Themes](https://www.one.com/en/wordpress-hosting/themes): Theme-related options for designing WordPress websites.
- [WordPress Plugins](https://www.one.com/en/wordpress-hosting/plugins): Extend WordPress functionality with plugin support and guidance.
- [WooCommerce Hosting](https://www.one.com/en/wordpress-hosting/woocommerce-hosting): Hosting optimized for WordPress ecommerce with WooCommerce.
- [Migrate to WordPress](https://www.one.com/en/wordpress-hosting/migrate-wordpress): Move an existing WordPress site to One.com hosting.

## Email and Productivity
- [Email Hosting](https://www.one.com/en/email): Domain-based email accounts for professional communication.
- [Microsoft 365](https://www.one.com/en/microsoft-office-365): Microsoft 365 plans for email and office productivity.
- [Webmail Login](https://login.one.com/mail): Access hosted email through the One.com webmail interface.
- [Calendar and Contacts](https://www.one.com/en/email): Email platform features for scheduling and contact management.
- [Email on Mobile](https://help.one.com/hc/en-us/categories/115000811205-E-mail): Support resources for configuring email on devices.
- [Email Security](https://www.one.com/en/email): Spam filtering and security features for hosted mailboxes.

## Domains and Online Presence
- [Domain Search](https://www.one.com/en/domain): Find available domain names and extensions.
- [Transfer Domain](https://www.one.com/en/domain-transfer): Move an existing domain to One.com.
- [Domain Prices](https://www.one.com/en/domain/prices): Review pricing for domain registration and renewals.
- [WHOIS](https://www.one.com/en/domain/whois): Look up domain registration information and ownership details.
- [SSL Certificate](https://www.one.com/en/ssl): Secure websites with SSL encryption certificates.
- [Business Email](https://www.one.com/en/email): Create branded email addresses using your own domain.

## Support
- [Help Center](https://help.one.com/hc/en-us): Main support portal with product help articles.
- [Website Builder Help](https://help.one.com/hc/en-us/categories/115000811185-Website-Builder): Support articles for building and editing websites.
- [Web Hosting Help](https://help.one.com/hc/en-us/categories/115000811225-Web-hosting): Help for hosting setup, files, and configuration.
- [WordPress Help](https://help.one.com/hc/en-us/categories/360000012258-WordPress): Support content for WordPress hosting and management.
- [Email Help](https://help.one.com/hc/en-us/categories/115000811205-E-mail): Email setup, troubleshooting, and client configuration guides.
- [Domain Help](https://help.one.com/hc/en-us/categories/115000811245-Domains): Articles about domains, DNS, and transfers.
- [Contact Support](https://help.one.com/hc/en-us/requests/new): Submit a support request to One.com.

## Account and Control Panel
- [Control Panel Login](https://login.one.com): Sign in to manage hosting, domains, and services.
- [Webmail](https://login.one.com/mail): Log in to hosted email accounts.
- [One.com Dashboard](https://login.one.com): Central account area for service administration.
- [Order Flow](https://www.one.com/en): Entry point for purchasing domains, hosting, and related products.
- [Password Reset](https://login.one.com/forgot-password): Recover access to a One.com account.
- [Manage Subscription](https://login.one.com): Access billing and subscription management after login.
